payload.core_mechanism_summary: Checks if the boundary streets form a directed cycle (clockwise or counterclockwise). If so, the grid is strongly connected; otherwise not.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a constant-time conditional on first/last directional characters, an ad-hoc observation. No DFS/BFS is performed. Among candidate subtypes, search_dfs_bfs_graph is the most relevant graph algorithm, but the match is weak.
